01 · Artiva specialism

Distinctive rules for a distinctive way of working.

Artistic work combines intermittency, short engagements, mobility and changing calendars. We turn that complexity into clear processes for production and administration teams.

02 · The production cycle

Employment management at the project’s real pace.

We connect planning, execution and closure so that information flows when it is needed.

03 · Technical precision

Every day counts. So does every detail.

Contributions and Social Security registration for artistic workers require the right activity, role, dates and pay to be identified from the outset. One early decision affects the whole employment cycle.
